title: Fail closed manifest capability omission and security evidence understatement

checks.name: capabilities_required
checks.detail: The root capabilities object and required/optional arrays are mandatory in schema, structure checks and runtime validation.

checks.name: capability_array_bounds
checks.detail: Required and optional capability arrays are bounded to 64 entries of 1-64 characters.

checks.name: signed_image_status_understatement
checks.detail: A not-found status cannot hide signed image blocks or trust-root evidence.

checks.name: efuse_summary_enums
checks.detail: Package eFuse security values are strict enums and invalid enabled-like strings are rejected.

checks.name: secure_boot_key_mismatch
checks.detail: Image key digest mismatch against package eFuse summary is rejected.

checks.name: secure_version_rollback
checks.detail: Image secure version below the package eFuse version is rejected.

checks.name: secure_boot_image_fixture_rebind
checks.detail: The static Secure Boot v2 image fixture passes all 26 checks against the new manifest/schema hashes.

notes: This is static manifest policy validation, not firmware runtime or hardware validation.
Package-provided eFuse summary authenticity remains unverified.
Live eFuse, bootloader trust-chain execution, anti-rollback enforcement and Flash Encryption runtime remain NOT RUN.
